# metabase_glossary_term (Resource)

A term in the Metabase glossary, along with its definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "metabase_glossary_term" "nmv" {
  term       = "NMV"
  definition = "Net merchandise value: the total paid by customers, excluding tips."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) The definition of the term.
- `term` (String) The term being defined.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the glossary term.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Use the integer ID from the Metabase API.
terraform import metabase_glossary_term.term 1
```
